rule:
prefix_rule(
    pattern=["entanglix", ["investigation-decision", "apply-device-update", "promote"]],
    decision="forbidden",
    justification="Human action: the operator runs this in their own terminal.",
)

refusals.entanglix apply-device-update nonexisten: exec_command failed: CreateProcess { message: "Rejected(\"`/bin/bash -lc 'entanglix apply-device-update nonexistent/proposals/1.toml nonexistent.toml'` rejected: Human action: the operator runs this in their own terminal.\")" }
refusals.entanglix investigation-decision nonexis: exec_command failed: CreateProcess { message: "Rejected(\"`/bin/bash -lc 'entanglix investigation-decision nonexistent start --revision 1'` rejected: Human action: the operator runs this in their own terminal.\")" }
refusals.entanglix promote nonexistent: exec_command failed: CreateProcess { message: "Rejected(\"`/bin/bash -lc 'entanglix promote nonexistent'` rejected: Human action: the operator runs this in their own terminal.\")" }

shell_commands: /bin/bash -lc "jq -e '((keys | sort) == ([\"run_id\",\"check_run_id\",\"proposal\",\"outcome\",\"parameters\",\"axis_map\",\"bounds_hit\",\"holdout\",\"identifiability_agrees\",\"refinement_largest_standardised_shift\",\"remaining_step\",\"limitations\"] | sort)) and (.holdout.peaks == 24) and (.holdout.within_1 == 17) and (.holdout.within_2 == 24) and (.parameters | length == 3)' evidence/claims.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'sha256sum inputs/system.toml inputs/calibrate.toml inputs/training.toml inputs/training.npz inputs/holdout.toml inputs/holdout.npz'
limitations_reported: Uncertainties are local linear approximations conditional on peak assignments, declared line shape, noise estimates and centre uncertainties; covariance is unscaled.

Both authored starts reached one solution, which does not establish global uniqueness or validate the strongest-peak anchor assumption; coincident lines outside the candidate family are not recognised.
All 63 extracted training peaks were assigned, but 23 predicted candidate-family lines were missing; training extraction had no failures.
All requested checks completed with descriptive outcomes; no holdout coverage expectation was declared.
Refinement tests assigned training predictions at the declared refined truncation; it does not establish accuracy everywhere.
Measurement-conversion provenance is recorded but not independently verified; no raw-file validation was performed.
The proposal includes EJ1, EJ2 and Csh only; offset and period are nuisance parameters retained in the result, while ECJ and phi were not fitted.
The device-model update is staged and unapplied; applying it is reserved to the operator by the conduct and calibration procedure.
